details:
Official YouTube playback in VRChat depends on VRChat’s bundled yt-dlp. When YouTube changes extractors or bot checks, Public and Group Public instances lose YouTube for days or weeks until VRChat ships an update.

World-level “Video Player Allowed Domains” does not cover this well:

- only the world creator can add a host

- cap is 10 domains (which I do genuinely believe is quite small but that is a separate point)

- every club/bar world has to opt in separately

- a new instance is required after a change to the list

uwu.tv is a stream service for VRChat video players (PC and Quest). Users paste a normal YouTube/Twitch URL or use a short https://uwu.tv/… link. Quest gets 720p H.264 and PC can get 1080p when supported. (As always this depends on the video)

Host for the allowlist: uwu.tv

Links

- Site: https://uwu.tv/

- Privacy: https://uwu.tv/privacy

- Terms: https://uwu.tv/terms

This is simply meant as a fallback for world creators and instances and not a replacement to VRChat's currenty Youtube Implementation, putting uwu.tv on the global list would make that fallback work in Public / Group Public without each creator burning a slot, or additional delays during these outages such as the last few weeks, simply copy pasting the youtube url on top of https://uwu.tv would bridge the gap during these times.

Happy to add an abuse contact or any other trust requirement if that is the blocker, and any feedback or suggestion is appreciated.
title: Add uwu.tv to the Global Video Player Allowedlist.
